method: Direct Steam store HTML via Invoke-WebRequest, l=english. Percentages are Steam's displayed rounded values. Cumulative counts are English Reviews, not all-language totals. Recent values are the Recent Reviews header for the last 30 days; the tooltip does not explicitly state language scope. Stardew English and Korean headers showed identical recent counts (6472) and percentage (97), while cumulative counts differed.
selection: Six farming/life/crafting candidates, not an exhaustive Steam ranking. Status and multiplayer evidence checked on official Steam store pages and announcements. Games were not played.

games.name: Stardew Valley
games.recent_scope: Past 30 days, Steam Recent Reviews header. Language scope not explicitly stated; identical values observed in English and Korean store HTML.
games.offtopic: No exclusion notice observed in header tooltip.

multiplayer.evidence: Steam description: 8 Player Farming; invite 1-7 players online.
